```{r}
#libaries
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(lmtest)
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
nba_data <- read_csv("Data/nba_team_stats_00_to_23.csv")

#Create ranking by wins (descending)

nba_data <- nba_data %>%
group_by(season) %>%
mutate(ranking = rank(-wins, ties.method = "first")) %>%
arrange(season, ranking)

write_csv(nba_data, "Data/nba_team_stats_ranked.csv")

nba_model <- read_csv("Data/nba_team_stats_ranked.csv")

```

```{r}
# for reproducibility
set.seed(325)
n <- nrow(nba_model)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.7 * n))

nba_train <- nba_model[train_idx, ]
nba_test  <- nba_model[-train_idx, ]

```

```{r}
vars_use <- c(
  "wins",
  "field_goal_percentage",
  "three_point_percentage",
  "free_throw_percentage",
  "assists",
  "turnovers",
  "offensive_rebounds",
  "defensive_rebounds",
  "steals",
  "blocks",
  "personal_fouls",
  "personal_fouls_drawn"
)

# Compute mean and SD for each variable
summary_stats <- nba_model %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(vars_use)) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(),
                   list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
                   na.rm = TRUE))

summary_stats

```



```{r}
#full model
full_mod <- lm(wins ~ field_goal_percentage +
                 three_point_percentage +
                 free_throw_percentage +
                 assists + turnovers +
                 offensive_rebounds + 
                 defensive_rebounds +
                 steals + blocks +
                 personal_fouls + 
                 personal_fouls_drawn,
               data = nba_train)

summary(full_mod)
vif(full_mod)

```

```{r}
step_mod <- stepAIC(full_mod, direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
summary(step_mod)
vif(step_mod)

```

```{r}
#offensive model
off_mod <- lm( wins ~ field_goal_percentage + three_point_percentage +
                 free_throw_percentage + assists + offensive_rebounds + turnovers,
               data = nba_train
               )

summary(off_mod)

```

```{r}
#defensive model
def_mod <- lm( wins ~ steals + blocks + defensive_rebounds + personal_fouls,
               data = nba_train
               )

summary(def_mod)

```

```{r}
# Offensive Interaction FG% × Assists

off_int <- lm( wins ~ field_goal_percentage * assists +
                 three_point_percentage + free_throw_percentage +
                 offensive_rebounds + turnovers,
               data = nba_train
               )
anova(off_mod, off_int)

#Defensive interaction block x de_rebounds

def_int <- lm( wins ~ blocks * defensive_rebounds + steals + personal_fouls,
               data = nba_train
               )

anova(def_mod, def_int)

```
```{r}
#final models

final_offensive_model <- lm(wins ~ field_goal_percentage +
                              three_point_percentage +
                              offensive_rebounds + turnovers,
                            data = nba_train
                            )

summary(final_offensive_model)

final_defensive_model <- lm(wins ~ steals + personal_fouls + blocks + defensive_rebounds,
                            data = nba_train
                            )

summary(final_defensive_model)

```
```{r}
#residual analysis

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot(fitted(final_offensive_model),
     resid(final_offensive_model),
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted (Offensive)")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

qqnorm(resid(final_offensive_model), main = "Q-Q Plot (Offensive)")
qqline(resid(final_offensive_model), col = "red")

plot(fitted(final_defensive_model),
     resid(final_defensive_model),
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted (Defensive)")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

qqnorm(resid(final_defensive_model), main = "Q-Q Plot (Defensive)")
qqline(resid(final_defensive_model), col = "red")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```

```{r}
nba_train <- as_tibble(nba_train)

# Add predictions to training data
nba_train <- nba_train %>%
  mutate(
    pred_off = predict(final_offensive_model),
    pred_def = predict(final_defensive_model)
  )

# Combine into long format for faceting
plot_data <- nba_train %>%
  dplyr::select(wins, pred_off, pred_def) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(pred_off, pred_def),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "pred_wins"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = ifelse(model == "pred_off", "Offensive Model", "Defensive Model")
  )

# Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = pred_wins, y = wins)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ model) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1: Predicted vs Actual Wins",
    x = "Predicted Wins",
    y = "Actual Wins"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("figure1_exploratory.png", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)


```
